label: first copy step (input = echoed first token) in long sequences starting with 3/o/2/p/f
explanation: Weak, sparse feature (max 0.28). About 73% of mass is at step L+1 (recall_idx 1), where the input is the echoed first original token, and almost all of that is in long sequences (L 8-9). The first token is heavily skewed toward 3, o, 2, p (and f), with 3 the strongest (10x lift); rate also rises with digit count. Most of the remaining ~26% of mass is at the last 1-3 original steps of long sequences, plus the delimiter step, again when the sequence starts with p/3/o; it never fires at t<3 or after recall_idx 2. Even when every condition holds it fires only ~5% of the time (precision 0.055), so some hidden-state combination we could not capture decides whether it fires. Activations are larger in L=9 and when the first token is 3, but no predicate pushed F1 past 0.16.
